trajectory_summary: This is a short, low-friction recycled-lead call where the customer arrives already sold and self-resolves her own prior objection (roof condition) before the rep has to do any persuasive work. The rep's main job was scheduling logistics, which he completed, but he let a substantive customer statement about a third-party-ownership/PPA-style program pass with a vague, non-committal acknowledgment instead of clarifying or flagging it for the closer.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: clarifying customer's understanding of program/ownership structure
primary_coaching_focus.quote: This was gonna be a program where I I would be you you would be the owner or you would rent it out to somebody, and I didn't have to pay for anything. And then I buy the the energy at a set price.
primary_coaching_focus.why: The customer describes an ownership/financing arrangement that doesn't get clarified or confirmed by the rep, leaving ambiguity that the closer will inherit without warning — a quick clarifying question here would have taken seconds and given the closer accurate context.

key_moments.quote: This was gonna be a program where I I would be you you would be the owner or you would rent it out to somebody, and I didn't have to pay for anything. And then I buy the the energy at a set price.
key_moments.stewart_read: The customer is describing what sounds like a third-party-ownership or PPA-style arrangement discussed in a prior touch. The schema's orphaned_flow section hard-DQs PPA/lease-with-no-buyout scenarios for existing systems, and while this is a proposed new system rather than an existing one, the ownership structure she's describing is compliance-relevant and should have been clarified rather than glossed over, since it affects what the closer can actually offer.

key_moments.stewart_read: The customer volunteers that she resolved her own roof concern and is now fully ready, a strong buying signal that the rep could have explicitly acknowledged and anchored on before pivoting straight to calendar logistics.
